facts.fact: The New Deal Technologique, the national digital strategy to 2034 launched on 24 February 2025, names the 'Dossier Patient Informatisé' among its health-sector outcomes and carries e-Santé in priority programme PR-P_11; the strategy is costed at 1,105 billion FCFA for all 12 programmes, with no figure for the patient record itself.

note: The patient record appears once, as a named outcome in the sector list beside digitalised health cover and telemedicine; the document states an intention and describes no deployment. The PDF is undated; 24 February 2025 is the launch date in the record's header.
